name: Snuggly Duckling Charcuterie Platter
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced cured ham/prosciutto and aged cheeses offer low-carb protein, though dense pumpernickel bread and coarse sausages need careful selection.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to the thinly sliced prosciutto/ham and aged cheese paired with the table's soft white pretzel bread; skip the seeded pumpernickel, whole-grain mustard, and pickled garnish.
